COMPANY OVERVIEW
Tata Group is an Indian multinational conglomerate company headquartered in Mumbai, India. It encompasses seven business sectors: communications and information technology, engineering, materials, services, energy, consumer products and chemicals. Tata Group was founded in 1868 by Jamsetji Tata as a trading company. It has operations in more than 80 countries across six continents. Tata Group has over 100 operating companies with each of them operating independently.
Tata Sons is the promoter of all key Tata companies and holds the bulk of shareholding in these companies.
BACKGROUND
The Tata companies together serve over million consumer and commercial customers today across several products and services. In order for the Tata companies to better understand customer and client needs and preferences, action life stages, needs, value, and potential, and enhance value and experience; the Tata companies need to develop robust data and information management capability and customer analytics. The vision is to eventually create the best in-house capability for data analytics amongst any large corporate. To achieve the above aims, it has been decided to establish an independent Tata company focused on building a common data analytics platform and help Tata Group companies. This company is being incubated in the initial phase as a division of Tata Industries and will subsequently be structured as a separate company to build Big Data Analytics and Data Science capabilities catering to but not limited to the Consumer brands of the group.

Role Type : Agentic Ai Specialist and Data Scientist
Location : Mumbai, Work from Office

Education and Experience


Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field; or MBA with Bachelors in the above fields
Experience of 1 -6 Years in data analytics companies, focused in data science with exposure to business data warehousing, data consumption, data analyses and use of Gen AI in analytics in a consumer (B2C) company, preferably in Retail or Ecommerce

About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Agentic Ai and Data Scientist to join our data science team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in Python, SQL, and machine learning, with recent hands-on projects delivered leveraging LLMs. They will play a key role in building data-driven solutions that drive business decisions and impact.

Job Description


- This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of the team that works as Agentic Ai Builder and develops foundational capabilities enabling enhanced analytics and measurement, critical to shaping global digital adoption and experience strategies.
- The incumbent will be part of the Customer Analytics team. He/she will be an individual contributor working on customer analytics space as primary responsibility. He/she would work with data to help their clients make better business decisions. Using techniques from a range of disciplines, he/she would draw conclusions from data to describe, predict, and improve business performance. Experience in any of the business domains of Customer Analytics, Retail Merchandising and Buying would be beneficial.


Job Responsibilities


Design and build scalable machine learning models and / or AI-first solutions to solve real-world business problems.
Translate business requirements into clear analytical solutions using data science techniques or AI agents ( Agentic Ai )
Write optimized SQL queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets. Develop and deploy production-ready code using Python.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to build end-to-end data and AI products.
Communicate complex findings in a clear, concise manner to non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously monitor and improve the performance of deployed models.
Mentor junior data scientists and review their code/models as needed.

Requirements/Skill sets


Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field; or MBA with Bachelors in the above fields
1+ years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics, AI and machine learning.
Strong grasp of how LLMs work (tokens, context windows, temperature, hallucination risks)
Experience with prompt engineering and structured outputs (JSON, function calling)
Familiarity with Agentic Ai frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, etc.)
Understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and when to use it vs fine-tuning
Ability to design multi-step Agentic Ai workflows (planning, tool use, memory)
Experience building Agentic Ai that Call APIs/tools, Handle retries and failures, Maintain state/context across interactions
Knowledge of evaluation strategies for Agentic Ai (accuracy, latency, cost, reliability)
Expert proficiency in Python, including libraries like pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, etc. async programming and API development
Experience with model deployment, version control (e.g., Git), and working in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure/ Databricks).
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have:


Experience on Databricks would be beneficial
Experience in any of the business domains of Retail Merchandising and Buying would be beneficial.

Job Summary

Alation is pioneering the next era of data intelligence - powered by AI agents and trusted data. Organizations around the world rely on Alation to drive self-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. With more than $340M in funding - valued at over billion and more than 650 customers, including 40% of the Fortune 100.

As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data-driven innovation with confidence and speed.

Joining Alation means being part of a winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence. We move fast, think big, and deliver results together.

As the Agentic AI Engineer for Content Enablement Systems within Digital Customer Experience, you'll spearhead the engineering behind Alation's next-generation enablement infrastructure. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you'll own the build-designing the systems that synchronize, structure, and personalize content at scale. You'll thrive in a collaborative environment that values your autonomy: while you lead end-to-end development, you'll partner closely with enablement team leads and technical partners. This partnership model ensures you have a supportive framework for tackling complex challenges and the mentorship to accelerate your professional growth, offering you true ownership over meaningful technical systems with a built-in foundation for success.

Core Responsibilities
Design and ship agentic workflows end-to-end - not just prompting, but the surrounding tooling: orchestration, retries, guardrails, and evaluation harnesses
Apply the same core skillset across genuinely different problems - drift detection, content pipelines, and personalization - rather than specializing narrowly in one
Build evaluation loops that catch failures before they reach production, not just after
Search indexing, retrieval API/MCP integration
Support retrieval infrastructure end-to-end - indexing strategy, relevance tuning, and diagnosing degradation in retrieval quality
Integrate and reason about MCP servers and APIs as a first-class part of system design, not a bolt-on
Editorial judgment enablement ops
Build systems that make human review of AI-generated content efficient, recognizing that a quality gate is still needed
Partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, Support, and field teams as ongoing stakeholders - not just at requirements-gathering, but throughout the build
What You Bring
3-5 years of relevant software engineering experience, with hands-on work building agentic AI systems, RAG pipelines, or similar retrieval-augmented applications
A systems-first mindset for designing modular AI agents that can scale across disparate data sources without creating technical debt.
Experience mapping complex, end-to-end agentic workflows to anticipate and mitigate failure modes before they reach production.
Experience with search/retrieval infrastructure - indexing, ranking, or relevance tuning
Familiarity with API integration and/or MCP (Model Context Protocol) server integration in agent-based systems
Comfort working cross-functionally with non-engineering stakeholders (PM, PMM, Support, Sales) to translate business content needs into technical systems
Strong judgment on when AI output needs human review vs. when it can ship autonomously
A Big plus
Experience in a fast-moving product company environment (vs. purely research or consulting settings)
Prior experience with content/documentation pipelines, developer enablement tooling, or knowledge-management systems
Experience with drift-detection or sync systems between code and documentation
Familiarity with evaluation frameworks/tooling for LLM-based agents specifically (not just traditional ML evaluation)
